args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production, health checks failed in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. I rolled checkout-api back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy, and the error rate is 0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before deploying it again.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident, which paged on-call.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. The test build (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to that. Now all three regions run v2.3.0, the health check passes, and the error rate is 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open as a SEV2 for checkout-api. It describes the failure, the rollback and the recovered numbers, and says the cause of the v2.3.1 failure needs to be found before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
